# Data Cleaning: Missing Values

::: {.callout-important icon="false"}
**Real Data is Messy!**

Learn to handle NA (Not Available) values
:::

```r
# Checking for missing values
is.na(data$column)           # Logical vector
sum(is.na(data$column))      # Count NAs
any(is.na(data))             # Any NAs?
complete.cases(data)         # Rows with no NAs

# Remove rows with ANY NA
data_clean <- na.omit(data)
data_clean <- data[complete.cases(data), ]

# Remove rows with NA in specific column
data_clean <- data %>% filter(!is.na(column_name))

# Replace NA with value
data %>%
  mutate(column = replace_na(column, 0))

# Replace NA with mean
data %>%
  mutate(column = ifelse(is.na(column), mean(column, na.rm=TRUE), column))
```

---

# String Manipulation

```r
library(stringr)

# Common string operations
data %>%
  mutate(
    upper_name = str_to_upper(name),
    lower_name = str_to_lower(name),
    name_length = str_length(name),
    contains_a = str_detect(name, "a"),
    replaced = str_replace(name, "old", "new"),
    extracted = str_extract(name, "[A-Z]+")
  )

# Pattern matching
data %>%
  filter(str_detect(column, "pattern"))

# Combining strings
data %>%
  mutate(full_name = str_c(first_name, last_name, sep = " "))
```

# Putting It All Together: Real Example

```r
# Analyze mtcars comprehensively
analysis <- mtcars %>%
  # Add row names as a column
  rownames_to_column("car_name") %>%
  
  # Create new variables
  mutate(
    efficiency = case_when(
      mpg > 25 ~ "High",
      mpg > 20 ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "Low"
    ),
    hp_per_cyl = hp / cyl,
    weight_class = ifelse(wt > 3.5, "Heavy", "Light")
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter to powerful cars
  filter(hp > 100) %>%
  
  # Select relevant columns
  select(car_name, mpg, hp, hp_per_cyl, efficiency, weight_class) %>%
  
  # Sort by horsepower
  arrange(desc(hp))

# Group analysis
summary_by_efficiency <- mtcars %>%
  mutate(
    efficiency = case_when(
      mpg > 25 ~ "High",
      mpg > 20 ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "Low"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(efficiency) %>%
  summarize(
    count = n(),
    avg_hp = mean(hp),
    avg_mpg = mean(mpg),
    avg_weight = mean(wt)
  )
```

# Quick Challenge! 🧠

```{=html}
<div class="quiz-box">
  <div class="quiz-question">Which pipeline finds cars with mpg > 20 AND cyl == 4, then calculates average hp?</div>
  
  <div class="quiz-options">
    <div class="quiz-option" onclick="checkDplyrQuiz(this, false)" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.8em;">
      mtcars %>% filter(mpg > 20 | cyl == 4) %>% mean(hp)
    </div>
    <div class="quiz-option" onclick="checkDplyrQuiz(this, true)" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.8em;">
      mtcars %>% filter(mpg > 20, cyl == 4) %>% summarize(avg_hp = mean(hp))
    </div>
    <div class="quiz-option" onclick="checkDplyrQuiz(this, false)" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.8em;">
      mtcars %>% select(mpg > 20 & cyl == 4) %>% mean(hp)
    </div>
    <div class="quiz-option" onclick="checkDplyrQuiz(this, false)" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.8em;">
      mtcars %>% group_by(mpg > 20) %>% filter(cyl == 4)
    </div>
  </div>
  
  <div id="dplyr-quiz-feedback" style="display: none;"></div>
</div>

<script>
function checkDplyrQuiz(element, isCorrect) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'incorrect');
  });
  
  element.classList.add(isCorrect ? 'correct' : 'incorrect');
  
  const feedback = document.getElementById('dplyr-quiz-feedback');
  feedback.style.display = 'block';
  feedback.className = 'quiz-feedback ' + (isCorrect ? 'correct' : 'incorrect');
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Perfect! filter() with comma means AND, and summarize() calculates the mean!';
  } else {
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite! Use filter() for rows, comma for AND, and summarize() for aggregation.';
  }
}
</script>
```

# Cheat Sheet: dplyr Verbs

| Task | Function | Example |
|------|----------|---------|
| **Select columns** | `select()` | `select(data, col1, col2)` |
| **Filter rows** | `filter()` | `filter(data, age > 18)` |
| **Create columns** | `mutate()` | `mutate(data, new = old * 2)` |
| **Sort** | `arrange()` | `arrange(data, desc(col))` |
| **Group** | `group_by()` | `group_by(data, category)` |
| **Aggregate** | `summarize()` | `summarize(data, avg = mean(x))` |
| **Count** | `count()` | `count(data, category)` |
| **Rename** | `rename()` | `rename(data, new_name = old_name)` |

## Challenge 3: Group By Logic

```{=html}
<div class="quiz-box">
  <div class="quiz-question">After <code>group_by(category)</code>, what does <code>summarize(avg = mean(price))</code> return?</div>
  
  <div class="quiz-options">
    <div class="quiz-option" onclick="checkGroupChallenge(this, false)">One overall mean price</div>
    <div class="quiz-option" onclick="checkGroupChallenge(this, true)">One mean price per category</div>
    <div class="quiz-option" onclick="checkGroupChallenge(this, false)">Original data with new column</div>
    <div class="quiz-option" onclick="checkGroupChallenge(this, false)">Error: need filter() first</div>
  </div>
  
  <div id="group-challenge-feedback" style="display: none;"></div>
</div>

<script>
function checkGroupChallenge(element, isCorrect) {
  document.querySelectorAll('#group-challenge-feedback').forEach(f => f.previousElementSibling.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'incorrect');
  }));
  
  element.classList.add(isCorrect ? 'correct' : 'incorrect');
  
  const feedback = document.getElementById('group-challenge-feedback');
  feedback.style.display = 'block';
  feedback.className = 'quiz-feedback ' + (isCorrect ? 'correct' : 'incorrect');
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! group_by() + summarize() = one row per group with aggregate statistics.';
  } else {
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Try again! group_by() splits data into groups, summarize() calculates stats for each group.';
  }
}
</script>
```
